_doc: Series the automatic ladder cannot see. Keyed on work.work_key.
_why: A series is a fact about the world, not something to compute. docs/info/isbn-ladder.md §4.4 records the shape of the mistake this file prevents: a wrong answer that scores 1.0 and has nothing textual to distinguish it from a right one. When the ladder in scripts/backfill-series.mjs cannot see a series and you know it, record it here rather than widening a regex until it fires.
_shape: "<work_key>": { "series": "Cradle", "index": 1, "display": "Book 1" }  — index may be null for a volume with no place on a number line (an Extra, a compilation); display is what the cover actually says.
_key: The work_key is normaliseTitle(title) + '|' + normaliseTitle(primaryAuthor). Read it out of the database rather than deriving it by hand: `SELECT work_key, title FROM work WHERE title LIKE '%…%'`.
_warning: ⚠️ Entries here override every other rung, including the audiobook catalog's own curated series column. That is the point, and it is also why a wrong entry here is invisible: nothing will contradict it.
_empty: Deliberately empty. The 2026-08-10 run left 37 works with no series, and every one of them is a book whose series is knowable but is not written down anywhere in either repo. Filling them in from memory is exactly what this project's phase-0 findings say not to do — three ISBNs typed from memory all resolved successfully, to three different books.
